title: Input-head rewind on a scanned symbol
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and suppose $E$ has at least one work tape. Choose states $e_0,e_f$ of $E$ and $g_0,g_f$ of $G$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. For any integer $p$ with $1\le p\le |x|$, one step of the machine formed by the loop body, from the configuration with state $\mathrm{rwInput}$, input head at position $p$, its first work tape storing $x$, all other work tapes blank, all work heads at position $0$, and empty output, leaves the state at $\mathrm{rwInput}$ and moves the input head to position $p-1$, with the tapes, work-head positions, and output unchanged.
